run_paco_query_evaluation: run PACO query evaluation on the paco_lvis_v1_test dataset using the R101 FPN cascade model
configure_paco_query_evaluator: configure the PACOQueryEvaluator with the paco_lvis_v1_test dataset name for query-based evaluation
override_test_dataset: override the test dataloader dataset names to paco_lvis_v1_test for query evaluation
import_base_model_config: import the R101 attribute FPN cascade 100 epoch base config for dataloader, model, train, lr_multiplier, and optimizer
setup_lazy_config_evaluator: setup a LazyCall PACOQueryEvaluator instance bound to the test dataset via Detectron2 config
